name: Gardis
source: Gardis is a demon lord who cares about his people. [Spoiler] It's revealed that Risty the protagonist of Queen of Darkness is his grandmother. After his mother killed herself to be with her lover who was human. Risty raised Gardis herself. By the time the game start Risty is already dead.
